question: In which of the following cities of India was the 1st Mayor's Trophy International Grandmaster Chess Tournament - 2023 organised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **1st Mayor's Trophy International Grandmaster Chess Tournament - 2023** was organized in **Indore**, India.
 
• This tournament marked a significant event in the Indian chess calendar, attracting grandmasters from various countries.
 
• Indore has been increasingly recognized for hosting major chess tournaments, promoting the game at both national and international levels.
 
• The event was aimed at encouraging young talents and providing them with a platform to compete against seasoned players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indore is known for its rich cultural heritage and has been a host to numerous sports events over the years.
 
• The city has excellent infrastructure to support international sports events, including chess tournaments.
 
• Such events play a crucial role in promoting chess as a sport and inspiring the younger generation to take up the game professionally.
 
• India has produced several renowned chess grandmasters, and events like these contribute to the country's growing reputation in the global chess community.
